What each line actually means

Package lists are easy to skim and hard to picture. Here is what each item turns into once it is set up.

Line itemWhat it means in practiceIn which package

SEO pagesAdditional pages written to be found in search for the services you offer.Empire

Email support / a dedicated account managerHow you reach us: by email, or with one named contact who knows your setup.Email in Starter; account manager in Empire

Single services

If one problem is all you have, you do not need a package. These are sold on their own:

Single servicePrice
AI voice agentsfrom $297/month
AI lead generationfrom $197/month
Website designfrom $497 one time

The AI voice agent price is the one most people come here for: it is an AI that answers your phone. Website design is a one-time price; the others are monthly.

Included in every package

  • Setup: we configure the agent, the calendar, the pipeline and the follow-up
  • Training: we show you how to read messages, use the CRM and request changes
  • Support: we fix wrong answers and update hours, services and prices as they change

What we do not promise

  • A setup time or a launch date, because it depends on how much your business needs the AI to know
  • A number of calls, leads, bookings or reviews
  • Texting of any kind until carrier approval clears
  • A connection to your existing booking or practice software before we have confirmed it works
  • Contract, trial, refund or cancellation terms on this page: ask us

Texting is not live yet. Voice works today. Text messages (missed call text back, text reminders and texted review requests) switch on once carrier approval clears; that approval is the A2P 10DLC registration US carriers require for business texting from a regular local number. Package items that would use texting, such as review requests and follow-up, run by email until then.

How much does AI cost elsewhere?

Prices across the market vary widely, because "AI receptionist" can mean a self-serve app billed by the minute or a managed service with setup included. Comparing our numbers to a software subscription is comparing a finished job to a box of parts.

The AI receptionist cost guide lays out the price models other providers publish, with sources, alongside what a human receptionist costs. Real quotes vary, so use it as a map, not a price list.

If you are weighing whether to spend anything at all, is an AI receptionist worth it is the place to start, and how it works shows what happens after you sign up.

Questions about a price? Call the main line. Ask the AI receptionist about the packages; it is a working sample of the voice agent you would be paying for.

Call (903) 636-7511

Pricing questions

How much does AI cost for a small business?

It depends on what you are buying. A do-it-yourself AI tool is a subscription you configure yourself; an agency charges for setting it up and running it. Here, a single AI voice agent starts at $297 a month and the packages run $597, $1,097 and $1,997 a month with setup, training and support included. For what other providers publish, see the AI receptionist cost guide.

What is your AI voice agent pricing?

AI voice agents start at $297 a month as a single service. The AI Starter package includes an inbound voice agent, AI Pro includes inbound and outbound, and AI Empire includes multiple voice agents. Which one you need depends on whether you only want calls answered, or also want the AI to place calls, which has its own consent rules under federal law.

How does your marketing automation pricing work?

Marketing automation is spread across a few lines. CRM automation setup is in AI Starter and full CRM automation is in AI Pro. On its own, AI lead generation starts at $197 a month, review management at $197 a month and social media automation at $97 a month. Anything that sends texts waits for carrier approval.

Is there a contract, a trial or a refund policy?

We do not publish contract terms, trials, refunds or cancellation terms, and we will not make them up on a web page. Ask us directly before you commit, and get the answer in writing. That is good advice with any AI agency, and our guide to choosing one lists the other questions worth asking.

What is included in the monthly price?

For every package, setup, training and support are included. That means we configure the system, show you how to read messages and the CRM, and keep correcting and updating it as your business changes. The services listed in the package are what you get. For a single service, ask us what is included before you sign up.

Hear the AI receptionist answer before you buy one

Call our main line. The AI receptionist that picks up is the same kind of agent we configure for clients, so you can test it with your own questions. Ask it about prices, setup or your industry, or leave a message for Maurice.
